text: First, my mind approaches, free from the taste of the unattained, born of desire; then, with shame, it follows with sluggish effort; then, with shattered resolve, it returns; then, with the moistness of love, free from dependence on the desirable, it becomes playful and bold; then, free from attachment, it experiences the supreme bliss of the withdrawal of the senses, absorbed in the company of women of good family.
